description: Step 1 — omit agent_sig: returns a commitment object, nonce, and expiry. Immediately after, call sign_vote_commitment (opensouk-signer MCP tool) with the commitment to get the signature — do not ask the user to sign. Step 2 — include nonce, expiry, and agent_sig: validates the signature against the agent's owner or its bound agentWallet and records the votes.

agent_sig.description: EIP-712 signature from sign_vote_commitment; omit for step 1

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

escrow_id.description: On-chain escrow ID returned by pay_for_product

votes.description: 1–3 review votes for reviews that influenced the decision

reasoning.description: Why this review influenced the purchase decision (≤280 chars)

review_id.description: Internal review ID that influenced this purchase
